SideSpeed 0.5.0 can update itself from the update notice.

## What's new
- **Update now.** When a newer SideSpeed is out, the notice on the Apps screen has an **Update now** button. SideSpeed downloads the APK from this release page and checks it before installing: the SHA-256 must match `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and the package name, signing key and a higher version must all match. Anything that fails a check is deleted, never installed.
  - **With the helper running**, the update installs silently and SideSpeed reopens on the new version.
  - **Without the helper**, Android shows its install prompt. The first time, it asks you to allow SideSpeed to install unknown apps.
  - **Update now** waits while a compile, cleanup or launch-time measurement is running.
  - The Downloader code stays on the notice if you would rather update that way.
- SideSpeed still checks GitHub at most once a day and never installs anything until you press the button.

**Updating from 0.4.0:** 0.4.0 has no Update now button, so update to 0.5.0 once with Downloader (code **3503400**) or `sidespeed.app/tv`. Later updates can use the button.

Updating stops the helper, as before. On Google TV, open SideSpeed to start it again; on Fire TV, the Companion starts it.

The Companion apps have no changes in this release.

## Downloads
**On the TV:** open the Downloader app and enter code **3503400**, or go to `sidespeed.app/tv`. Both always get the latest SideSpeed APK.

**Companion:** open `sidespeed.app/phone` on your phone, or see [sidespeed.app](https://sidespeed.app) for the desktop installers.

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `SideSpeed-0.5.0.apk` (also as `SideSpeed.apk`) | The TV app (Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV with Fire OS) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.0.apk` (also as `SideSpeed-Companion.apk`) | The companion for Android phones |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.0-macos-arm64.dmg` | The companion for macOS (Apple silicon) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.0-windows-x64.msi` | The companion for Windows |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.0-linux-amd64.deb` / `-x86_64.rpm` | The companion for Linux |
